# Source C: Evolution System

Evolution operates in shadow mode only. It cannot modify Policy, expand Tool grants, raise Risk ceiling, obtain Secrets, enable external write, bypass Release Gate, or auto-promote generated tools to trusted.
Cold start safety: N<10 uses pure rules, 10<=N<50 uses linear weight, N>=50 uses weight=0.3.

Contradiction with Source A: Source A claims the Router DAG replaces parallel routers entirely.
However, this source notes that the Profiler stage still uses a single LLM call, which is sequential, not parallel.
This is not a true contradiction — the DAG replaces parallel routers, but individual stages may still be sequential.
